verdict.rationale: Ollama is headless by design. It installs via a scriptable one-line shell command, exposes a REST API callable with curl, and ships Python/JS libraries. Community users run it as a server for bots and embedded products, on Linux without the GUI and in ROCm containers. This covers unattended automation, but no evidence documents CI usage specifically. missing for 10: first-party CI/pipeline documentation or examples (e.g. GitHub Actions), documented headless server/daemon configuration, a published OpenAPI spec (probe 404).
